core_obligations: Reduce to the sheaf case (proof lines 7889-7905): the author chooses a representative of the bounded below complex K_0 and observes that it suffices to prove the statement for the individual cohomology sheaves, since the pullbacks and pushforwards involved commute with the truncations.
Apply the sheaf statement (proof lines 7905-7920): the sheaf case is the companion result of the same chapter, applied to the cohomology sheaves of the chosen representative.
Conclude for the complex (proof lines 7920-7928): reassembling the statements for the cohomology sheaves gives the asserted identification of the higher direct images for K.
proof_roadmap: Replace the complex by a bounded below representative and pass to its cohomology sheaves.
Apply the companion sheaf-level result to each cohomology sheaf.
Reassemble the identifications to obtain the complex-level statement.
difficulty_reason: The lemma generalises the companion limit result to coefficients in a bounded below complex: the higher direct images of the pullback of K_0 along the limit morphism are the colimits of the pullbacks of the corresponding higher direct images at finite stages (statement lines 7876-7887, whose notation is fixed by the companion statement delivered as a context span from lines 7566-7582). The proof reduces to the sheaf case by passing to the cohomology sheaves of a bounded below representative (proof lines 7889-7905), applies the companion statement sheaf by sheaf (proof lines 7905-7920) and reassembles the result (proof lines 7920-7928). The non-formal content is the passage from sheaves to complexes through the truncations. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one application of the companion result.
